comments.author: Ryan Rafferty
comments.body:
You did a great job with your pheonix build, and I look forward to your new pinstripe theme... it really makes Mozilla on OS X feel like it belongs.

The problem with the official firebird release is that it doesn't follow OS X interface guidelines, I'm also not a huge fan of the icon. I hope you are able to persuade the Mozilla team to adopt your theme for 1.5- it would be a shame to see such a milestone with such little support for some very basic things in OS X.

comments.author: Kevin
comments.body: You could vote for this bug if you'd like to help persuade people Replace existing Fizzilla Classic theme with Gerich's Pinstripe theme :)

comments.author: mog
comments.body: I can't tell it apart in my dock from plain old Mozilla. Now I have two Phoenix versions, yours and the official one. Not sure on the interface as I have my OS X skinned and the browser sortof fits but it needs better icons. So does Camino for that matter. Still trying out the official one.

comments.author: alex
comments.body: I hope to see mail icons at some point too - the standard icons stick out like a sore thumb with the elegant pinstripe theme. :)

comments.author: Josh
comments.body: Although I never got the chance to use your unofficial port, thanks for doing it...

comments.author: Neil
comments.body: Boy, now that there are official Firebird builds, I really, really hope that you get a Pinstripe theme out soon. I feel like I'm running a Windows XP program on my Mac, which is a bit discombobulating. Any news?

comments.author: Kevin
comments.body: I have started bringing Pinstripe to Firebird, though I just got back from a trip to Virginia and haven't had much free time lately. I hope to do some work on it next weekend.
